def: to settle down, i.e. (literally) to colonize, or (figuratively) to (cause to) desist

occurrences.text: And with these sayings scarce restrained they the people, that they had not done sacrifice unto them.
For he spake in a certain place of the seventh day on this wise, And God did rest the seventh day from all his works.
For if Jesus had given them rest, then would he not afterward have spoken of another day.
For he that is entered into his rest, he also hath ceased from his own works, as God did from his.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
